newsitem.title: UK: Vickers close to sale of medical division - paper.
newsitem.headline: Vickers close to sale of medical division - paper.

text.p: UK engineering group Vickers Plc is close to completing the long-awaited sale of its medical systems division, the Independent on Sunday reported.
The newspaper said the move would pave the way to an agreed merger with British Aerospace. Vickers was not immediately available for comment on Sunday.
The Independent said Vickers was hoping to announce the sale of the division when it publishes its half-year results in September.

In June the company announced it was to sell its S&W Medico Teknik unit to Sweden's Artema Medical AB. The newspaper said since then, observers have been expecting the sale of the remaining businesses, which make incubators and electronic monitoring equipment.
The newspaper said while no deal has been concluded, it is understood that one of the leading contenders for the division is Smith Industries, which has extensive healthcare technology interests.
